description: RGB domain 0x10 version 6 golden vectors for firmware and Charybdis Ark (D-F14): version 5 with the leading colour (D-F72). Stage bit 5 is the replacement feedback stage (D-F70); header byte 14 counts its group rows and byte 15 stays reserved; after the behaviour feedback group rows the payload ends with one thirteen-byte replacement feedback record (the text, macro, undo and leading colours, then a locality of 0 to 4) and five-byte replacement group rows (selector 0 text, 1 macro, 2 undo, 3 leading or 0xFF all; a colour; a group). The 640 group rows in all count five tables. Derived from the version 5 vectors by setting the version and putting a leading colour before the locality: the compiled aa ff c8 where the record holds the compiled colours, 00 00 00 elsewhere; offsets past it move by three. The vectors named replacement-* and those ending -with-replacement are built on 'compiled'. 'compiled' is the firmware's compiled RGB domain. Error codes are the firmware's NOAH_PROFILE_RGB_V1_* names; offsets are payload-relative. D-F63 raised the ceilings to 128 groups and 640 group rows in all, 255 in one table.
